integrity_notes: Closed forms are proved by exhaustive rational spherical height chambers and exact great-circle moment identities. An independent computation checks all finite chamber signs; floating-point evaluation and weighted simulation corroborate but do not replace the proof. The source posting date is the day-verified 2014 arXiv geometry reference. Older related work published in 1988 has year-level publication evidence only and is explicitly examined for overlap. Priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Only the motion-invariant affine-plane measure conditioned on hitting the specified regular rhombic dodecahedron is covered; tangent/vertex-degenerate planes have zero measure. The law is not invariant under general nonsimilar affine maps. No section area or perimeter law is asserted.
title: Seven-atom Crofton polygon-type law for the rhombic dodecahedron
